How it's calculated
MAIN KPI = net SM on the bench. Actual = -(number of Store Manager vacancies) from the HRP 'HRP & Bench' roster (the red 'Gap / no SM' stores); target = +3; miss = target - actual (e.g. -3 vs +3 = 6 off, red). How it's calculated
Youda onboarding compliance across the first 90 days: a starter is compliant when every step due on their checklist is done. Estate headline = share of the cohort fully compliant. Target 90%. Detail breaks it down by step, site and starter.
The end-of-summer peak, the back-to-school fall-away, and how trade reconcentrates onto the weekend once term restarts. Built from BigQuery 2025 actuals scaled by each store’s recent year-on-year trend. Schools return Wednesday 2 September 2026. Generated 13 Sep 2026, 13:09.

Method & caveats. Actuals from BigQuery v_sales_details_flat. 2026 forecast = 2025 same-week actual × each store’s recent 8-week YoY (capped 0.85–1.25). Weekday/weekend profile compares 3 holiday weeks (11–31 Aug 2025) with 3 term weeks (8–28 Sep 2025); weekend = Fri–Sun. Schools return Wed 2 Sep 2026 — Mon 31 Aug (bank hol) & Tue 1 Sep (INSET) still trade holiday-like, so the transition week is a hybrid. New stores (Billing DT, Attleborough, Olney) have no 2025 history — sales estimated from run-rate × estate seasonal shape; weekend-shift & food not shown for them.
